Carmen (Product): Prototype up — quick screen grab + figma link https://figma.com/file/abc123 — thinking about keyboard-only access to the 'Advanced burst options' accordion and how the 'Spot/Preemptible' pool badge reads. feedback? :eyes: Alex (Eng): looks slick. :thumbsup: one issue: when adv panel opens the SLO slider loses keyboard focus and page scrolls. keyboard users get lost. Priya (Eng): yeah that happened in my local. cause is we re-render the panel into a different DOM node on expand. quick fix: keep it in DOM and toggle `aria-hidden` instead of removing it. also set focus to first control after expand: `document.querySelector('#burst-min').focus()` Mei (A11y): Agree with Priya. Use `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby` on the panel, and set `aria-expanded` on the toggle. To avoid scroll jump: set `tabindex="-1"` on the panel container then `panel.focus()` — that gives context without moving the page. Jonah (PM): Copy thought on the pool badge: instead of 'Preemptible' maybe 'Spot — interruptible, cheaper' with a tooltip like 'May be reclaimed; cheaper pricing' so ppl immediately get tradeoff. Also add small delta under pool name like '-35%' for quick cost signal. Carmen (Product): I like 'Spot — interruptible, cheaper' but worried about clutter. suggestion: badge short text 'Spot (interruptible)' + on-hover tooltip with the extra line. show price delta beneath pool name in muted text. Alex (Eng): for keyboard flow propose: Tab -> toggle -> Space expands -> focus first slider -> Escape collapses. avoid modal semantics so SRs still read the page in context. can we guard the SLO slider so its value doesn't jump when panel animates? Mei (A11y): Use the WAI-ARIA accordion pattern. snippet:```
...
``` That plus `panel.focus()` after `aria-expanded` flips should satisfy screenreaders and keyboard users. Priya (Eng): sounds doable. small perf note: aria-hidden toggles are cheap; avoid full remount to keep slider state. Carmen (Product): awesome — I'll update the figma and capture the keyboard flow in the prototype. @eng-runtime-bot can you flag if toggling `aria-hidden` instead of remounting has infra implications for our component library? eng-runtime-bot: noted — will check component wrappers and reply in this thread tomorrow. :robot_face: Carmen (Product): thanks all, I'll post the new frames when done. :sparkles:
